name: Soulwrecking Strike (Combat, Mythic)
body:
You cause unbearable pain to a possessing entity, forcing it to leave its host.

Prerequisite(s): Soulwrecking Strike.

Benefit(s): You can choose to inflict non-lethal damage to the possessed creature and lethal damage to the possessing entity. If you confirm a critical hit against the host, the possessing entity is forced to leave, as per banishment.
